events.title: LORE and LAND — First Nations artists in the Art Collection
events.source: Caloundra Regional Gallery / Sunshine Coast Council
events.description: An exhibition showcasing First Nations artists from the gallery collection, exploring themes of lore and land through visual arts.

events.title: SILENT FILM – DR JECKYLL & MR HYDE (1920)
events.source: The Majestic Theatre / Pomona Arts Inc
events.description: A screening of the 1920 silent classic Dr. Jekyll & Mr. Hyde at a historic theatre, offering a unique atmospheric experience of early cinema.

events.title: Fauna Monitoring at Mary (Cairncross Conversations)
events.source: Sunshine Coast Council / Mary Cairncross Scenic Reserve
events.description: An intellectually engaging talk about wildlife research and fauna monitoring techniques within the local rainforest reserve, aimed at curious community members.
